title: Vermont Statutes Annotated, Title 30 (Public Service), Chapter 5 - State Policy; Plans; Jurisdiction and Regulatory Authority of Commission and Department
verified_how: fetched https://legislature.vermont.gov/statutes/chapter/30/005 (HTTP 200): headings 'Title 30 : Public Service' and 'Chapter 005 : State Policy; Plans; Jurisdiction and Regulatory Authority of Commission and Department', subchapter heading 'Subchapter 001 : GENERAL POWERS' listing s 201 (Definitions) onward and including s 208b (Unauthorized billing), s 212f (Identification of Department sales on bills), s 216 (Gas rate fixing), s 218 (Jurisdiction over charges and rates), s 225 (Rate schedules), s 226 (Rates, hearings, bond), s 230 (Special rate or rebate; penalty) and s 231a (Registration of billing aggregators); the Title 30 index gives 'Chapter 005 ... Contains: ss 201 - 271'. Every page of the Vermont Statutes Online carries the currency line 'The Statutes below include the actions of the 2025 session of the General Assembly.' and the caveat 'NOTE: The Vermont Statutes Online is an unofficial copy of the Vermont Statutes Annotated that is provided as a convenience.' No repeal marker appears on the cited provisions; repealed sections elsewhere in the same chapters are explicitly flagged 'Repealed. <act cite>', so the absence of that marker is meaningful.
notes: The statute confers rate and charge jurisdiction on the Public Utility Commission; day-to-day billing, deposit, arrears and disconnection practice is set by PUC rule rather than by statute, so the statute is the enabling layer only.
